texts.zh: [Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称[From.GetName]上的巨大结构实际上是某种未知外星生物的庞大遗骸。这具遗骸不仅巨大到能从[primitive_planet.GetName]轨道上通过肉眼直接看到，而且它似乎还在不断大量散布某种作用于精神层面的化学物质，或许一直影响着这颗行星上有机生物的神经系统。
texts.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the enormous structure located on [From.GetName] is in fact the gargantuan corpse of some unidentified alien creature. Not only is the corpse large enough to be seen with the naked eye from [primitive_planet.GetName], it also appears to be shedding large quantities of psychotropic chemicals that may have neurological side effects for organic life forms on the planet.

label.zh: 在进一步调查之前抓点儿小零食好了。
